propositions: Per-criterion fan-out recovery is eliminated; verified criteria from primary are banked incrementally and only unverified remainder is batched into successor runs, reducing worst-case token cost from 440 requests to measured ~110–150.

Criterion bank is run-scoped, stamped with ticket/material/tree provenance, idempotently keyed by deterministic criterion ID (c<index>-<sha256>[:8]), and enforces a 3000-char evidence cap per entry with explicit truncated flag.

Successor batch size is capped by resolved model class slot (standard/frontier/trivial → 8/12/8 criteria), with pool arithmetic pinned to criteria count c: floor=clamp(8c, 48, 480), N=ceil(floor/2), global pool=1.5×N, and per-run allocation floor(pool_remaining/runs_remaining) with batch-shrink re-planning below launch floor.

Primary step budget is criteria-scaled via verify_step_floor(c)=clamp(8c, 48, 480) instead of flat 480, reducing overbudgeting of small tickets (e.g., 8-criteria from 480 to 64) and eliminating manufacture of runaway-guard exhaustion without sacrificing large-ticket ceiling.

Finalizer emits full-coverage verdict with banked criteria scored and unbanked criteria as met=false unverified placeholders; on finalizer failure, deterministic no-LLM fallback assembles verdict directly from bank with certifiable=false, guaranteeing no verdict-less state when any progress is banked.

Read_file memo key is normalized by path (not exact signature); whole-file read is cached on first access and all subsequent range reads are sliced from cache, collapsing 77% re-read tax measured in prior diagnostics.
